question: The Indian Army contingent that took part in the fourth edition of Exercise AUSTRAHIND 2025 held in Australia was commanded by a battalion of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Gorkha Rifles**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The **fourth edition** of the joint military exercise **AUSTRAHIND 2025** was held in **Australia**, representing a significant milestone in the bilateral defense cooperation between the **Indian Army** and the **Australian Army**.
 
• The Indian Army contingent for this specific edition was led and commanded by a battalion of the **Gorkha Rifles**, which is one of the most distinguished and decorated infantry regiments of the **Indian Army**.
 
• The exercise focused on enhancing **interoperability** and the exchange of best practices in **tactical operations**. It involved joint training in diverse environments, particularly focusing on **sub-conventional operations** in **semi-urban** and mountainous terrain.
 
• The training curriculum included **joint planning**, **sniper firing**, tactical drills, and **combat engineering** tasks, ensuring that both forces are prepared for modern warfare challenges under a **United Nations mandate**.
